features.name: mean_sentences_per_counter_comment
features.definition: What is the mean number of sentences per counter-argument comment?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments with json.loads into a list of strings. If missing/malformed return null; if the list is empty return null. For each comment, count sentences by splitting on regex (?<=[.!?])\s+ after stripping, dropping empty segments (newline-separated paragraphs also split sentences when non-empty). Return the mean sentence count across comments (sentences per comment).

h0: mean_sentences_per_counter_comment has no association with the probability that the OP changed their view (delta).
h1: Higher mean_sentences_per_counter_comment is associated with a higher probability that the OP changed their view.
note: Persuasiveness is operationalized as the dataset outcome delta (OP view change). Row-level aggregation by mean sentences per comment is an assumption; the hypothesis does not specify mean vs total or maximum. Sentence splitting is a regex heuristic (abbreviations, lists, and URLs may be miscounted). OC_comments may include comments posted after or containing delta/view-change announcements; raw counts are not outcome-free. Comment order and timing are unknown. Association only, not causal.
